Updated PortfolioViewController::show() to call getActivity(portfolio_id, 10) via a new private getPortfolioActivity() helper and pass results as `activities` to the template. Added a 'Recent Activity' section to Template/portfolio/show.php below Milestone Health with date/event/task-link/project columns, portfolio- prefixed CSS classes, and an empty state message. Added 3 translation strings. Added 2 controller tests to PortfolioViewControllerTest (activity passthrough + empty state). Fixed a pre-existing PHPCS brace error. All 163 tests pass, 0 lint/PHPCS errors, PHPStan clean.
phaseRuns.reflectionSummary: All 5 stories completed so far (US-001 through US-005) are done. 4 stories remain open (US-006 through US-009). Implementation is fully aligned with PRD intent — no drift detected across any iteration.
phaseRuns.nextIterationPlan: Next story: US-006 (Add portfolio workload API method) — highest-priority open story. Backend-only: add getWorkload() to PortfolioTaskModel, register getPortfolioWorkload JSON-RPC callback in Plugin.php, add portfolio_workload_threshold config setting, update ConfigController and settings template, add 3+ unit tests.
